title: consumerism
meaning_vi: chủ nghĩa tiêu dùng

examples.en: Rampant consumerism encourages people to buy more food than they can realistically consume.

title: demographic's
meaning_vi: (noun (possessive)). thuộc về một nhóm nhân khẩu học

examples.en: Fast food chains often tailor their menus to a younger demographic's tastes.

title: mechanisms
meaning_vi: cơ chế

examples.en: New marketing mechanisms have allowed food companies to reach wider audiences online.

title: purchasing habit
meaning_vi: thói quen mua sắm

examples.en: Advertisements on social media have significantly changed young people's purchasing habits.

title: become increasingly prevalent
meaning_vi: trở nên ngày càng phổ biến

examples.en: Online grocery shopping has become increasingly prevalent since the pandemic.

title: expect a significant reduction
meaning_vi: dự đoán sự sụt giảm đáng kể

examples.en: During economic downturns, restaurant owners often expect a significant reduction in customer numbers.

title: cultural food identity
meaning_vi: bản sắc ẩm thực văn hóa

examples.en: The rise of global fast-food chains poses a threat to cultural food identity in many countries.

title: local agriculture and food culture
meaning_vi: nông nghiệp và văn hóa ẩm thực địa phương

examples.en: An overreliance on imports can undermine local agriculture and food culture.

title: decline in traditional food practices
meaning_vi: sự suy giảm các tập quán ẩm thực truyền thống

examples.en: The dominance of imported convenience foods has led to a decline in traditional food practices.

title: Extreme people
meaning_vi: những người có quan điểm cực đoan

examples.en: Extreme people on both sides of the debate often ignore the nuances of food policy.

title: general public
meaning_vi: công chúng, người dân nói chung

examples.en: Public health campaigns aim to educate the general public about balanced diets.

title: makeup conspiracies
meaning_vi: bịa đặt ra các thuyết âm mưu

examples.en: Some online groups makeup conspiracies claiming that food regulators are hiding health risks.

title: out of the blue
meaning_vi: bất ngờ, đột ngột

examples.en: The new sugar tax was introduced out of the blue, catching many manufacturers off guard.

title: tobacco and alcohol products
meaning_vi: các sản phẩm thuốc lá và rượu bia

examples.en: Governments often impose heavy taxes on tobacco and alcohol products to discourage consumption.

title: oppressive
meaning_vi: hà khắc, áp bức

examples.en: Some critics argue that a sugar tax is an oppressive measure that unfairly targets the poor.

title: an effective deterrent
meaning_vi: một biện pháp răn đe hiệu quả

examples.en: Higher fines for food safety violations can act as an effective deterrent for negligent restaurants.

title: apply a sugar-tax
meaning_vi: áp dụng thuế đường

examples.en: Several countries have chosen to apply a sugar-tax to reduce soft drink consumption.

title: avoid lawsuits for food poisoning
meaning_vi: tránh các vụ kiện do ngộ độc thực phẩm

examples.en: Restaurants follow strict hygiene protocols to avoid lawsuits for food poisoning.

title: expiry-date standards
meaning_vi: tiêu chuẩn về hạn sử dụng

examples.en: Clearer expiry-date standards would help consumers distinguish between food that is unsafe and food that is merely past its best.

title: government intervention
meaning_vi: sự can thiệp của chính phủ

examples.en: Some economists believe government intervention is necessary to curb unhealthy eating habits.

title: implement a sugar tax on all their products
term: implement a sugar tax on all their products
pronunciation: /ˈɪm.plɪ.mɛnt ə ˈʃʊɡ.ə tæks ɒn ɔːl ðeə ˈprɒd.ʌkts/
meaning_vi: áp dụng thuế đường lên toàn bộ sản phẩm của họ

examples.en: Regulators are pressuring beverage companies to implement a sugar tax on all their products.

title: implementing a fine
meaning_vi: áp dụng một khoản phạt

examples.en: Some cities have reduced food waste by implementing a fine for businesses that discard edible produce.

title: levy a tax
meaning_vi: đánh thuế

examples.en: Several governments have chosen to levy a tax on sugary beverages to curb consumption.

title: maintain freshness standards
meaning_vi: duy trì tiêu chuẩn độ tươi

examples.en: Strict regulations require restaurants to maintain freshness standards for all perishable ingredients.

title: special taxes
meaning_vi: thuế đặc biệt

examples.en: Special taxes on sugar have been introduced in several countries to discourage unhealthy diets.

title: transparent
meaning_vi: minh bạch, rõ ràng

examples.en: Food companies should be more transparent about the ingredients used in their products.

title: aesthetic standard
meaning_vi: tiêu chuẩn thẩm mỹ

examples.en: Rigid aesthetic standards mean that perfectly edible but misshapen produce is frequently thrown away.

title: ascribed
meaning_vi: (verb (past participle)). được quy cho, gán cho

examples.en: The sharp rise in food waste is largely ascribed to changing consumer attitudes towards leftovers.

title: bulk-buying incentive
meaning_vi: ưu đãi mua số lượng lớn

examples.en: Retailers' bulk-buying incentives often encourage households to purchase more food than they can consume.

title: careless purchasing habits
meaning_vi: thói quen mua sắm bất cẩn

examples.en: Careless purchasing habits, such as buying in bulk without planning meals, contribute heavily to household waste.

title: consumer mindset
meaning_vi: tư duy của người tiêu dùng

examples.en: Changing the consumer mindset towards overbuying is crucial to tackling household food waste.

title: devaluation
meaning_vi: sự mất giá, hạ thấp giá trị

examples.en: The devaluation of food in wealthy societies has made people careless about how much they throw away.

title: excess
meaning_vi: sự dư thừa

examples.en: Restaurants often prepare food in excess to avoid disappointing customers during peak hours.

title: excessive commercial food production
meaning_vi: sản xuất thực phẩm thương mại quá mức

examples.en: Excessive commercial food production often results in surplus stock that supermarkets simply throw away.

title: food consumption rate
meaning_vi: tỷ lệ tiêu thụ thực phẩm

examples.en: Researchers found that household food consumption rates have risen sharply over the past decade.

title: irresponsible consumer behaviour
meaning_vi: hành vi tiêu dùng thiếu trách nhiệm

examples.en: Overbuying perishable items is a clear example of irresponsible consumer behaviour that fuels waste.

title: Large-scale restaurants
meaning_vi: các nhà hàng quy mô lớn

examples.en: Large-scale restaurants often generate significant amounts of food waste each day.

title: legitimate reasons
meaning_vi: những lý do chính đáng

examples.en: Restaurants sometimes discard food for legitimate reasons, such as hygiene regulations.

title: logistical shortcoming
meaning_vi: thiếu sót về hậu cần

examples.en: Poor storage facilities and other logistical shortcomings contribute significantly to food loss in developing countries.

title: overabundance
meaning_vi: sự dư thừa quá mức

examples.en: An overabundance of cheap processed food has made healthy eating less of a priority for many families.

title: purchase excessive quantities
meaning_vi: mua số lượng quá mức

examples.en: Shoppers tend to purchase excessive quantities of groceries whenever supermarkets run buy-one-get-one-free deals.

title: rarity
meaning_vi: sự hiếm có

examples.en: Unlike previous generations, food is no longer a rarity for most people in developed countries.

title: supply chain
meaning_vi: chuỗi cung ứng

examples.en: Inefficiencies at every stage of the supply chain can result in enormous quantities of edible food being discarded.

title: the oversupply of food
meaning_vi: tình trạng dư thừa thực phẩm

examples.en: The oversupply of food at large retailers frequently leads to edible produce being discarded unnecessarily.

title: a glut of products
meaning_vi: sự dư thừa sản phẩm

examples.en: Overproduction can lead to a glut of products that eventually go to waste.

title: carbon intensity per calorie
meaning_vi: cường độ phát thải carbon trên mỗi calo

examples.en: Researchers found that air-freighted fruit has a far higher carbon intensity per calorie than seasonal local produce.

title: edible food
meaning_vi: thực phẩm ăn được

examples.en: Supermarkets throw away tonnes of perfectly edible food every year simply because of packaging damage.

title: environmental repercussions
meaning_vi: hậu quả đối với môi trường

examples.en: Long-distance food transportation carries serious environmental repercussions that policymakers cannot ignore.

title: food waste
meaning_vi: lãng phí thực phẩm

examples.en: Food waste remains one of the most pressing sustainability challenges facing modern societies.

title: household waste
meaning_vi: rác thải hộ gia đình

examples.en: Composting schemes have significantly reduced household waste in several European cities.

title: post-harvest losses
meaning_vi: tổn thất sau thu hoạch

examples.en: In many developing countries, post-harvest losses account for a significant proportion of total food waste.

title: routinely discarded
meaning_vi: thường xuyên bị vứt bỏ

examples.en: Fruit that fails to meet cosmetic standards is routinely discarded before it even reaches shop shelves.

title: substantial fuel consumption
meaning_vi: mức tiêu thụ nhiên liệu đáng kể

examples.en: Transporting food across continents involves substantial fuel consumption, worsening greenhouse gas emissions.

title: the cost to both the environment and to people is too great
term: the cost to both the environment and to people is too great
pronunciation: /ðə kɒst tuː bəʊθ ði ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt ənd tuː ˈpiː.pl ɪz tuː ɡreɪt/
meaning_vi: cái giá phải trả cho cả môi trường lẫn con người là quá lớn

examples.en: Many environmentalists argue that the cost to both the environment and to people is too great to ignore food waste.

title: widespread transit of food
meaning_vi: việc vận chuyển thực phẩm trên diện rộng

examples.en: The widespread transit of food across continents raises serious concerns about carbon emissions.

title: a balance between food supply and demand
term: a balance between food supply and demand
pronunciation: /ə ˈbæləns bɪˈtwiːn fuːd səˈplaɪ ənd dɪˈmɑːnd/
meaning_vi: sự cân bằng giữa cung và cầu thực phẩm

examples.en: Retailers use sales data to maintain a balance between food supply and demand.

title: avoid over-preparing food
meaning_vi: tránh chuẩn bị dư thừa thức ăn

examples.en: Restaurants can reduce waste by learning to avoid over-preparing food during quiet hours.

title: cold-chain logistics
meaning_vi: hệ thống hậu cần chuỗi lạnh

examples.en: Investment in cold-chain logistics can prevent perishable goods from spoiling before they reach consumers.

title: commendable
meaning_vi: đáng khen ngợi

examples.en: Donating unsold meals to shelters is a commendable practice that many restaurants have adopted.

title: consumer awareness programme
meaning_vi: chương trình nâng cao nhận thức người tiêu dùng

examples.en: Launching consumer awareness programmes can help households understand the true cost of food waste.

title: efficient consumption
meaning_vi: sự tiêu thụ hiệu quả

examples.en: Meal planning apps encourage efficient consumption by helping users buy only what they need.

title: environmental advantage
meaning_vi: lợi ích môi trường

examples.en: Buying seasonal produce offers a clear environmental advantage by cutting transport emissions.

title: food-bank organization
meaning_vi: tổ chức ngân hàng thực phẩm

examples.en: Food-bank organizations play a vital role in redistributing surplus food to those in need.

title: Homeless shelters, orphanages
meaning_vi: các trung tâm bảo trợ người vô gia cư, trại trẻ mồ côi

examples.en: Surplus food from supermarkets is often donated to homeless shelters, orphanages, and other charities.

title: menu-planning workshop
meaning_vi: hội thảo lập kế hoạch thực đơn

examples.en: Community menu-planning workshops teach families how to shop more efficiently and waste less food.

title: portion control
meaning_vi: kiểm soát khẩu phần ăn

examples.en: Practising portion control at home not only benefits health but also reduces food waste.

title: problem-solving
meaning_vi: sự giải quyết vấn đề

examples.en: Tackling food waste calls for creative problem-solving at every stage of the supply chain.

title: raise consumer's awareness
meaning_vi: nâng cao nhận thức của người tiêu dùng

examples.en: Labelling schemes can raise consumer's awareness of how much food ends up in landfills.

title: redirected to disadvantaged groups
meaning_vi: được chuyển hướng đến các nhóm yếu thế

examples.en: Surplus supermarket food is increasingly redirected to disadvantaged groups through charity partnerships.

title: redistribution
meaning_vi: sự phân phối lại

examples.en: The redistribution of surplus produce to food banks helps reduce both waste and hunger.

title: refrigerated transport network
meaning_vi: mạng lưới vận chuyển lạnh

examples.en: Expanding refrigerated transport networks would drastically reduce post-harvest spoilage in rural regions.

title: remedy
meaning_vi: khắc phục, giải quyết

examples.en: Better inventory forecasting could remedy the problem of excess stock going to waste.

title: resource efficiency
meaning_vi: hiệu quả sử dụng tài nguyên

examples.en: Improving resource efficiency throughout the food system is essential to feeding a growing population sustainably.

title: reuse leftovers
meaning_vi: tái sử dụng thức ăn thừa

examples.en: Cooking shows now encourage viewers to reuse leftovers instead of throwing them away.

title: tax incentive
meaning_vi: ưu đãi thuế

examples.en: Offering tax incentives to businesses that donate surplus food could substantially cut national food waste levels.

title: to introduce a reasonable quota of food waste
term: to introduce a reasonable quota of food waste
pronunciation: /tʊ ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs ə ˈriːznəbl ˈkwəʊtə əv fuːd weɪst/
meaning_vi: đưa ra một hạn ngạch hợp lý về lãng phí thực phẩm

examples.en: Policymakers are considering plans to introduce a reasonable quota of food waste for large supermarket chains.

title: ensure the best food conditions
meaning_vi: đảm bảo điều kiện thực phẩm tốt nhất

examples.en: Some governments subsidise cold-chain storage in order to ensure the best food conditions for products travelling long distances.
